# entrepot_role_binding (Resource)

Grants a role to a subject on the repositories matching a pattern. Bindings are immutable: changing any attribute replaces the binding.

Subjects are users (OIDC usernames, or `sa:<name>` for service accounts — use `entrepot_service_account.<x>.username`), OIDC groups, GitLab trust policies, or every authenticated principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let the CI service account publish to every npm-* repository.
resource "entrepot_role_binding" "ci_npm" {
  role               = entrepot_role.publisher.name
  subject_type       = "user"
  subject            = entrepot_service_account.ci.username # "sa:ci"
  repository_pattern = "npm-*"
}

# Members of the OIDC group "platform-admins" administer the whole server.
resource "entrepot_role_binding" "admins" {
  role         = "admin"
  subject_type = "group"
  subject      = "platform-admins"
}

# Every signed-in user can read the public-* repositories.
resource "entrepot_role_binding" "readers" {
  role               = "viewer"
  subject_type       = "authenticated"
  repository_pattern = "public-*"
}

# GitLab CI jobs matching a trust policy can upload to the internal repositories.
resource "entrepot_role_binding" "gitlab_ci" {
  role               = "developer"
  subject_type       = "gitlab_policy"
  subject            = entrepot_gitlab_trust_policy.platform.name
  repository_pattern = "internal-*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Role name: a built-in role (`viewer`, `developer`, `maintainer`, `admin`) or an `entrepot_role`. Changing it forces a new binding.
- `subject_type` (String) `user`, `group` (OIDC group), `gitlab_policy` (an `entrepot_gitlab_trust_policy`) or `authenticated` (anyone who is signed in). Changing it forces a new binding.

### Optional

- `repository_pattern` (String) Glob over repository names (default `*`, all repositories). A role with `admin` on `*` grants system administration. Changing it forces a new binding.
- `subject` (String) Username (`sa:<name>` for service accounts), group name or trust policy name. Required unless `subject_type = "authenticated"`, where it must be omitted. Changing it forces a new binding.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned binding ID (used for import).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role bindings are imported by their ID (see GET /api/v1/role-bindings).
terraform import entrepot_role_binding.ci_npm 3f2b8f1e-6a0c-4f43-9f57-2d7f4b1c9e10
```
